record_title: Rikitake stationary mean-height floor and sharp equality rigidity
provenance: Exact stationary polynomial balance laws for the autonomous Rikitake two-disc dynamo, combined with Cauchy-Schwarz and invariant-set tangency to obtain a sharp mean-height floor and equality classification.
limitations: The result is a necessary constraint and does not establish existence or uniqueness of recurrent states. Unbounded Rikitake trajectories exist, so the forward-orbit statement assumes boundedness. Equality rigidity requires a>0; at a=0 periodic states on x=y attain the floor. Full theorem-level inspection of some older primary sources was incomplete, leaving residual originality risk; originality is to the best of our knowledge.
